_note: Skeleton for docs/commit-subject-issue-refs.json — the factory data file read by tests/test_commit_subject_issue_refs.py (issue #529). Copy it into docs/ (the example itself is never read) and set `marker` to the instant from which this factory judges the clause: a commit whose AUTHOR date is greater than the marker, and whose subject cites an issue the ledger has CLOSED before that author date, must itself add a ledger row whose subject names that issue. Pick the instant the gate lands — the clause is FORWARD-ONLY by design, because a history-wide form is permanently red on any factory with a past, and a gate nobody can green is a gate the next lane learns to ignore. The marker is NOT an exemption: it is the boundary, and history before it is history rather than a backlog. An instant is the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and nothing else — a date alone, a bare timestamp with no zone, or a committer date is a gate FAILURE, never a silent fallback, because a declared parameter that cannot be honoured is a defect and not an absence. Add an entry to `exemptions` ONLY when a violation has an EMPTY REPAIR SPACE: the commit is pushed and cannot be amended, a revert cannot clear a gate that reads history, and re-anchoring the marker past the violation would make the marker's own definition false and silently convert a live violation into an excused one. Key every entry by the FULL 40-character sha copied from live git output — a short sha or a tag matches nothing while looking like it should. The entry must PROVE the empty repair space and state the reason. It is printed as an 'excused:' line on EVERY gate run, so it is a visible debt rather than forgiveness, and the closing line distinguishes clean from excused. A malformed entry, or one that matches no violation, is a gate ERROR rather than a silent pass. A second entry of the same shape is a process defect, not an exemption: one is a debt, two mean the mechanism — a commit that cites a closed issue lands together with the row that settles it — is not biting. This file is FACTORY DATA and never ships: the gate is byte-paired into TEMPLATE/, so a marker baked into it would travel into every factory that copies this tree, where it names nothing. That is why the gate's own copy carries no default marker and SKIPs with its reason until a factory declares one.
